claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Tower 或 IQE 的一手文件寫出這份 InP 磊晶片協議縮減、終止或最低承諾未履行。核查頻率：每半年（Tower 20-F／6-K、IQE 期中與年度結果）。觸發後 48 小時：本 claim 加註，IQE 敘事與 InP 磊晶片層讀圖重讀。
claims.statement: Customer-side filing (Tower 6-K): IQE's InP epiwafers will be used in several of Tower's silicon photonics platforms; the multi-year agreement has a first-year minimum purchase commitment by Tower, a reciprocal supply commitment from IQE and minimum volume commitments thereafter. Amounts and volumes are not disclosed.

nodes.name: Indium Phosphide (InP) epitaxial wafer (laser and photodetector epi)

source_doc.permission_basis: 美國 SEC 法定申報（Form 6-K 附件新聞稿）；只保留研究必要的逐字摘錄（HTML 實體已解碼）。published_at 取 EDGAR filed date。
source_doc.title: Tower Semiconductor Ltd. Form 6-K（2026-06-15）——IQE and Tower Semiconductor Announce Multi-year InP epiwafer Supply Agreement

sources.quote: IQE’s InP epiwafers will be used in several of Tower’s advanced silicon photonics platforms for next-generation optical technologies, providing a high-quality supply base for Tower’s product roadmap.

sources.locator: Exhibit（新聞稿）Tower 總裁 Dr. Marco Racanelli 引言
sources.quote: We are pleased to partner with IQE as a key supplier for our next-generation photonic technologies that add InP high-performance components to our high-volume, mature, silicon photonics platform.
The agreement provides for a minimum purchase commitment by Tower in the first year, a reciprocal supply commitment from IQE, and minimum volume commitments thereafter.
